create_positional_embeddings: create sinusoidal position codes for a given number of positions and embedding dimension
build_transformer_model: build a TransformerModel with configurable heads, layers, dimension, and vocabulary size for sequence encoding
run_multihead_attention: run multi-head self-attention on a batched sequence tensor with a padding mask
build_transformer_ffn: build a TransformerFFN feed-forward network with configurable hidden dimension and dropout
run_transformer_adapter: run a TransformerAdapter to encode context and candidate sequences using shared embeddings and dual transformers
